name: context-lens
description: See what fills your context window, what changed last turn, and where tokens are wasted

autoOpen.title: Open the pane at session start
autoOpen.description: in-app opens it in the desktop app and VS Code only; in a terminal, /ctx opens it

ablationModel.title: Model for /ctx ablate replays
ablationModel.description: haiku is cheap and good enough for most tests; sonnet is closer to the session's own model

largeOutputTokens.title: Flag tool outputs above this many tokens
largeOutputTokens.description: Tool results at least this big are listed as likely waste

compactionHints.title: Add notes to /compact
compactionHints.description: Tell the summarizer which files were edited, which blocks mattered, and which reads are stale
